versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02078, SRS_Com_02094 The AUTOSAR COM module shall support the following data types: • boolean • uint8 • uint16 • uint32 • uint64 • sint8 • sint16 • sint32 • sint64 • uint8[n] • float32 • float64 The type uint8[n] is mapped to either ComSignalType UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN .
